directions.name: Kinetic Dispatch Theatre
directions.metaphor: A physical dispatch machine turns an unanswered signal into a structured opportunity
directions.material: Matte cobalt enamel, opaque ivory frame, paper cards, rubber rails and restrained indicator light
directions.composition: Product theatre with one pinned machine stage and continuous mechanical chapters
directions.typography: Bold geometric grotesk display with durable neutral reading text and sparse mono operational data
directions.motion: Cards advance, rails fill and modules lock into place through scrubbed mechanical movement
directions.palette: Cobalt depth, matte ivory, ink navy and controlled module accents
directions.media: Existing pre-rendered dispatch-machine loop with poster and coded SVG frame
directions.navigation: Transparent frame-aligned navigation that compresses into a denser blue bar after hero movement
directions.conversion: Free lead-system review remains visible before and after the narrative

directions.name: Operational Blueprint
directions.metaphor: A lead is traced across an accountable routing plan
directions.material: Uncoated blueprint paper, plotted ink, registration marks and annotated service records
directions.composition: Operational atlas with split ledgers, route diagrams and data-first editorial pages
directions.typography: Condensed engineered display, humanist text and dense mono annotations
directions.motion: Paths draw, annotations resolve and route states switch with short precise reveals
directions.palette: Blueprint navy, chalk white, signal cyan and paper grey
directions.media: Top-down diagrams and static machine details
directions.navigation: Persistent utility rail with route state
directions.conversion: Diagnostic audit framed as a system inspection

directions.name: Human Relay
directions.metaphor: A chain of people and moments keeps a customer request from being dropped
directions.material: Documentary daylight, warm paper, handwritten shift notes and practical service environments
directions.composition: Human-perspective editorial narrative with image-led handoffs and quieter reading chapters
directions.typography: Warm humanist display with highly legible sans text and minimal labels
directions.motion: Slow image dissolves, handoff cuts and restrained text reveals
directions.palette: Ink blue, warm ivory, daylight neutrals and one safety accent
directions.media: Authentic staff and service-business documentary photography
directions.navigation: Simple editorial masthead with direct contact action
directions.conversion: Trust-led consultation after the operating story

selection_reason: It is the user-approved system, uses the supplied machine asset, makes the customer journey understandable, and preserves LYCORE's distinctive cobalt identity without unrelated SaaS motifs.
